newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM says Mt Isa flood impact minimal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM says Mt Isa flood impact minimal.

text.p: Base metals miner MIM Holdings Ltd said on Monday flooding caused by torrential rains has stopped rail traffic at its Mt Isa mining operations in north-west Queensland but the impact has been minimal.
"My understanding is it (the rain) is having an impact, but it is minimal at the moment," MIM general manager, corporate affairs, Collin Myers told Reuters.
"The railway line is cut but, subject to no more rain, we expect it (the line) to be restored in a day or two," Myers said.
Myers said MIM used the rail line to transport bulk products including zinc concentrate, lead bullion and copper anode.
"It should be only a delay of a day or two," he said.
Underground mining operations were not affected, Myers said.
The Leichhardt River at Mt Isa is at its highest level in 10 years as rain from a tropical cyclonic low continues.
MIM shares were two cents lower at A$1.77 at 1.20 p.m. (0220 GMT) on Monday.
